caption: A black robotic gripper approaches the small metal saucepan on the back-right burner, grasps it, lifts it, and carries it leftward to set it on the back-left burner. The gripper then picks up the yellow lemon from the front of the stovetop and releases it into the saucepan.

A single robot arm moves from the right burner area, lifts a red-and-white brush-like tool, and lays it across a light green bowl. It then reaches to the left, grasps a green-handled spatula, carries it over the metal pot, and leaves it standing inside the pot.

A single robot arm lowers its gripper onto a long silver bar and uses the bar to push through the scattered black beads. It sweeps and repositions the bar across the tabletop, corralling the beads into a tighter elongated pile on the right before lifting and moving away.

A robot arm pulls back from the upper handle, moves forward to engage it again, and swings the upper cabinet door outward toward the left. The door opens progressively while the lower door remains closed, and the arm finishes near the opened panel in a fixed external view.

A yellow parallel-jaw gripper moves forward toward an upright blue rectangular foam block beside black tape markings. A second yellow gripper enters from the left, contacts the block, and carries it leftward out of the central view. The first gripper remains open below as the view shifts back over the tabletop.

The wrist-mounted view shifts from an open cardboard box toward a blue bone-shaped toy on a black mat. White gripper jaws close around the toy, lift and carry it into the box, then release it inside. The gripper withdraws, leaving the toy in the box.

A red two-jaw gripper advances across the white tabletop toward a small patterned paper cup. The camera moves with the end effector as the cup grows larger, then passes over its rim and looks down into the empty interior, where the circular bottom remains in view.

The right robotic hand moves toward a red apple on the tabletop, closes around it, lifts it, and carries it leftward over a yellow plate. It lowers the apple into the center of the plate, releases it, and withdraws while the other robotic arm remains nearby.

A yellow-jawed gripper advances toward a long blue rectangular block beside a black guide, closes around the block, and lifts it upright. The camera travels with the grasped block across the tabletop as a second yellow gripper contacts its side. The block is then moved out of view, leaving the table clear.

The right robotic hand moves toward the red round object on the wooden board, closes around it, lifts it, and carries it rightward over the metal pan. It lowers and releases the object into the pan, then withdraws while the left hand remains open beside the board.

The two-jaw gripper descends toward a small glass flask at the center of the table, closes around its neck, and lifts it. The arm carries the flask leftward over a white circular laboratory device, lowers it onto the device’s top surface, then releases and withdraws upward.

The right anthropomorphic robot hand reaches toward a red apple on the table, closes around it, lifts it, and carries it leftward over the yellow bowl. The hand lowers the apple into the bowl, releases it, and retracts while the apple remains inside.

A wrist-mounted view moves across the black perforated work surface toward a red apple. Two opposing gripper jaws close around the apple’s sides, carry it leftward over a white plate, then lower and release it so the apple rests centered on the plate.

The right anthropomorphic robot hand reaches from the right toward a red apple beside the yellow bowl, closes around it, lifts it over the bowl, and releases it inside. The hand opens and withdraws to the right while the apple remains in the bowl.

The right robotic hand reaches toward a red apple on the tabletop, closes around it, and lifts it. It carries the apple leftward over the yellow plate, lowers it into the plate, releases it, and retracts, leaving the apple centered inside the plate.

A robot-mounted view advances toward a tall blue rectangular block beside black tape markings on a wooden surface. A second yellow jaw gripper enters from the left, closes around the block while the lower gripper supports it, then lifts the block out of view. The camera withdraws, leaving the marked surface empty.

The two-jaw gripper moves down toward a black upright cylindrical peg, closes around it, and carries it toward a cross-shaped black base. It positions the peg vertically into the base, opens its jaws to release it, then lifts and retreats, leaving the peg standing in the base.

A green two-jaw gripper moves in from the right, contacts and lifts the orange-and-white ball, then carries it toward the nearby blue-and-tan ball. It lowers the orange ball onto the other ball, releases it, and retracts rightward, leaving the two balls stacked together.

The wrist-mounted camera and its yellow gripper move across the wooden work surface toward a long blue rectangular strip. A second yellow gripper enters from the left, closes around the strip near its lower end, and moves it upward and left as the camera withdraws, leaving the nearby tabletop clear.

A single white robot arm moves its two-finger gripper toward the upper silver handle, clamps onto it, and pulls the upper wooden drawer front outward to the left. The front swings open, revealing the empty light-wood interior while the lower drawer remains closed.

A blue two-jaw gripper approaches a clear plastic cup on the dark work surface, guides it toward a white circular platform, and positions it over the platform. The view then shifts upward and sideways, keeping the gripper and the control panel of the white device in view.

A robotic parallel-jaw gripper descends toward an upright transparent tube at the center of the table, closes around it, and lifts it clear. The arm tilts the tube sideways while moving left, then returns it upright to its original central area, sets it down, opens the jaws, and retracts upward.

The right robotic hand lowers onto the yellow corn cob, closes around it, lifts and carries it leftward over the yellow plate, then releases it onto the plate. The hand withdraws to the right while the left robotic hand remains still.

The left robotic hand moves toward the yellow fruit-shaped object beside the plate, closes its fingers around it, lifts and carries it rightward over the plate, then opens to release it near the plate's center. The right hand remains poised beside the red fruit.

The wrist-mounted view rises from the table edge and moves toward a blue rectangular block. The foreground parallel-jaw gripper closes around the near end to hold it steady while a second gripper approaches from the right, clamps the block, and lifts it away, leaving the tabletop clear.

A yellow two-jaw gripper moves across the wooden work surface toward a blue rectangular block. It closes around the block, lifts it, carries it toward the black taped corner on the right, and sets it upright just inside the marked area before withdrawing.

The right robotic hand lowers toward the cucumber on the tabletop, closes its fingers around it, and lifts it. It carries the cucumber leftward over the yellow plate, lowers it onto the plate, releases it, and withdraws, leaving the cucumber resting across the plate while the left hand remains still.

A blue two-finger gripper holds a clear glass container, carries it across the dark work surface, and lowers it onto the circular platform of a white digital scale. The gripper stays around the container as the scale display changes while the camera moves closely with the end effector.

The wrist-mounted view moves forward from the wooden tabletop toward a blue rectangular block beside a black rail. The yellow parallel-jaw gripper closes around the block and lifts it upright, carrying it across the table. A second gripper contacts the block from the right, after which the primary gripper releases and withdraws.

The right robotic hand moves down to the dragon fruit, closes its fingers around it, lifts it from the tabletop, and carries it rightward over the gray plate. It lowers the fruit onto the plate, releases it, and withdraws slightly while the left hand remains still.

A wrist-mounted camera moves across the wooden work surface toward a tall blue rectangular block beside black tape markings. The foreground clamp closes around and carries the block leftward across the table while a second gripper approaches from the left. The block then leaves view as the camera returns to the empty tabletop.

A white two-jaw robot gripper moves forward toward the lower-left area of a red-and-white character board. The jaws align beneath an open red flap, press against the board’s lower section, then retreat, leaving the board and its flaps visibly in place.

The robot’s right hand reaches from the right side toward a red apple near the center-right of the table, closes around it, lifts it slightly, and carries it leftward over a yellow bowl. It lowers and releases the apple into the bowl, then withdraws while a person watches from across the table.

The wrist-mounted view moves across a wooden tabletop toward a blue rectangular block near black tape markings. A yellow parallel-jaw gripper closes around the block, lifts and carries it leftward to a taped rectangular area, sets it upright inside the marked space, opens to release it, and withdraws.

The robot hand moves downward from the upper-right toward the red apple, curls its fingers around the apple, and lifts it slightly off the tabletop beside the yellow pear. The orange fruit and white bin remain stationary as the fixed overhead view continues.

The viewpoint turns across a wooden surface as a metal-tipped, dark-handled tool enters from the right. A pair of blocky gripper jaws positions the tool upright in the center, then holds it steadily against the wood with slight adjustment.

The right robotic hand approaches the green translucent cup, closes around it, and lifts it from the table. It carries the cup to the basket on the right, tilts it to pour several small colorful pieces inside, then returns the emptied cup to the table beside the resting left hand.

A white two-jaw gripper moves forward from the tabletop toward a red animal-picture guessing board. It approaches the middle panels, briefly pauses close to the open red flaps, then withdraws, leaving several flaps open and the animal cards exposed.

The wrist-mounted view moves across the tabletop toward a tall blue rectangular block. The foreground two-finger gripper closes around the block and carries it across the surface while a second gripper approaches from the right and contacts its side. The block is then moved out of view, leaving the tabletop clear.

The red two-jaw gripper moves across the white tabletop toward a tan cup with a coffee-bean pattern. It closes in around the cup’s lower side without a clearly visible grasp, then backs away and repositions, briefly bringing the cup close to the camera before leaving it on the table.

The robotic hand retracts out of the right side of the workspace, then returns low beside the red apple. Its fingers close around the apple, lift it from the tabletop, and carry it upward and off to the right, leaving the yellow pear and orange object in place.

The right robotic hand closes around a yellow ear-of-corn-shaped object on the table, lifts it, and carries it leftward above a yellow plate. The left hand reaches in to receive the object, then lowers and releases it onto the center of the plate while both hands withdraw.

The wrist-mounted view moves across the wooden work surface toward a tall blue rectangular block beside black tape markings. The foreground yellow gripper closes around the block. A second yellow gripper reaches in from the right, takes the block, and lifts it away, leaving the first gripper over the cleared tabletop.

The foreground yellow gripper advances along the taped lane toward a blue rectangular block, closes around its lower sides, and lifts it upright off the table. A second yellow gripper approaches from the right, contacts the raised block, and pulls it rightward until it tilts away and leaves the first gripper open.

A blue robotic gripper enters from the left and approaches a small pink drumstick-shaped object beside a shallow pink dish. It closes around the object, lifts and carries it rightward and downward, then releases it inside the dish before withdrawing to the left.

The wrist-mounted camera tilts down as the red two-finger gripper approaches a rectangular yellow-and-green scrubbing sponge. The jaws close around the sponge and lift it toward the camera, then carry it sideways past a large blue-green round container while keeping the sponge secured.

The wrist-mounted view moves across the wooden work surface toward a bright blue rectangular block. A second gripper-equipped arm appears beside the block while the camera-side gripper takes hold, carries it rightward to a black-tape-marked area, and releases it upright within the taped boundary.

A two-jaw robot gripper moves forward over the perforated work surface toward a red apple beside a white bowl. The jaws close around the apple, lift and carry it leftward over the bowl, then lower and release it so the apple rests inside the bowl.

The left robotic hand moves toward the red apple beside the plate, closes its fingers around it, lifts it, carries it rightward over the turquoise plate, and releases it near the plate's center. The hand withdraws while the grapes remain in place.

The right anthropomorphic robotic hand moves toward the green cluster beside the pink plate, closes around it, lifts it, and carries it leftward over the plate. It releases the cluster near the plate center, leaving it resting inside while the other hand remains beside the yellow object.

The red two-finger gripper moves forward across the white tabletop toward a paper cup with a blue base. The cup is lifted or brought very close to the camera, briefly filling the view, then moves away toward the upper left as the gripper returns to an open position over the table.

A wrist-mounted view moves across the wooden work surface toward a tall blue rectangular block beside black tape markings. The front gripper closes around the lower part of the block and carries it forward. A second gripper enters from the right, grasps the block, lifts it away, and leaves the first gripper open above the cleared surface.

A white robot arm moves down toward a small yellow cup beside a countertop appliance, closes its two-finger gripper around the cup, and slides it leftward onto the appliance’s drip tray beneath the dispensing area. The gripper releases the cup and retracts to the right, leaving it upright in place.

The two white gripper jaws move away from the small blue-and-gray rounded object on the black ribbed surface. The viewpoint swings and tilts toward the edge of the workspace while a larger orange-and-gray rounded part enters the lower foreground, partially obscuring the surface.

A wrist-mounted gripper moves across the taped wooden work surface toward a blue rectangular block beside a black tape line. The block fills the center as the gripper advances alongside it. A second yellow gripper approaches from the left and contacts the block, after which the block leaves view and the camera retreats over the empty tabletop.

A yellow robotic gripper moves across the wooden work surface toward a tall blue rectangular block held near the left side. It closes around the block, carries it rightward along the black tape boundary, lowers it beside the marked corner, and releases it upright before withdrawing.

A robotic hand moves in from the right and lowers toward the red ball near the center-right of the table. Its fingers close around the ball, securing it, then the arm lifts the ball upward and slightly rightward, leaving the tabletop clear beneath it.

A blue two-finger robotic gripper approaches a clear plastic cup on the dark work surface, closes around its rim, and carries it diagonally toward a white digital scale. The gripper lowers the cup onto the scale’s circular platform while the camera follows closely, ending with the cup resting on the scale.

A white parallel-jaw gripper advances toward the red-and-white game board, aligns with a lower red hinged panel, and makes contact. The panel swings outward into an open horizontal position in front of the board. The gripper then withdraws, leaving the opened panel visible as the view pulls back.

The red two-finger gripper tilts downward and approaches a brown-and-dark abrasive sponge beside a round blue-gray surface. It closes around the sponge, lifting it into the center of view, then carries it while the wrist-mounted camera rotates slightly, keeping the sponge firmly held.

A single robotic arm carries a bright pink ball from the right toward a white rectangular bin near the center of the table. It lowers the ball over the open bin, releases it inside, and retracts upward, leaving the ball resting in the bin.

The robot's right articulated hand approaches the red apple on the tabletop, closes around it, lifts it slightly, and carries it leftward over the yellow bowl. It lowers the apple into the bowl, releases it, and retracts while the other robot hand remains visible near the table edge.

The wrist-mounted view pans across the marked wooden workspace as a second yellow gripper brings a blue rectangular block toward the foreground gripper. The foreground jaws secure the block, carry it leftward along the taped lane, then open and leave it standing upright inside the outlined area.

The wrist-mounted view moves across the marked wooden work surface toward a tall blue rectangular block. The foreground gripper closes around the block, then a second yellow gripper approaches from the right and takes hold. The blue block is lifted and carried away to the right, leaving the tabletop clear.

The right robotic hand moves toward the green grape cluster beside the plate, closes its fingers around it, lifts it over the plate, and releases it into the plate. The cluster settles near the lower-left interior while the left robotic hand remains still beside the yellow fruit.

The right robotic hand lowers toward the pale cloth, pinches its near edge, and lifts it upward, folding the fabric over itself. The cloth becomes a smaller layered bundle near the center of the table while the left hand remains open and still beside it.

A pink two-jaw gripper moves across a white tabletop toward an empty beige paper cup, closes around its sides, and lifts it. The cup fills the view as it is carried and rotated above the table, briefly revealing nearby scissors, another cup, and room furnishings before it is held steady.

The left robotic hand moves inward toward the yellow oval object beside the turquoise plate, closes its fingers around it, lifts and carries it over the plate, then releases it near the center. The right robotic hand remains poised beside the red fruit without interacting.

A white robot arm lowers its blue two-finger gripper to a small upright transparent object near the center of the black-covered table, closes around it, lifts it, and carries it leftward toward a clear cup. The arm then moves the object back and sets it upright near its original central position before retracting.

The wrist-mounted view moves across a wooden work surface toward a tall blue rectangular block beside black tape markings. The foreground gripper closes around the block’s near end while a second yellow gripper approaches from the left. The blue block is then lifted or pulled away, leaving the marked tabletop clear.

The right robotic hand approaches the yellow corn cob on the table, closes around it, and lifts it. It carries the cob diagonally up and right toward the yellow plate, lowers it onto the plate, then opens and withdraws, leaving the cob resting on the plate.

A white robotic gripper approaches the blue bone-shaped toy on the black mat, closes around it, lifts it, and carries it rightward over the open cardboard box. It releases the toy into the box, where it lands on the bottom; several similar blue toys remain on the tabletop beside the box.

The right robot arm moves in from the lower right toward a red apple beside a yellow plate, closes its gripper around the apple, lifts and carries it leftward over the plate, then releases it near the plate's center. The arm withdraws to the right while the apple remains on the plate.

The wrist-mounted view moves across the wooden work surface toward a tall blue rectangular block beside black tape markings. The yellow gripper closes around the block and carries it across the table. A second yellow gripper approaches from the right to contact the block, after which the block is removed from view and the first gripper withdraws.

A parallel-jaw gripper moves over the perforated work surface toward a red apple, closes around its sides, lifts it, and carries it leftward over a white bowl. The gripper lowers the apple into the bowl, releases it, and withdraws, leaving the apple centered inside.

A robot arm carries a green apple over the white plastic bin on the right side of the table, lowers it into the bin, releases it upright near the center, and lifts its open hand away while the camera remains fixed.

The right robotic hand approaches the green cluster beside the pink plate, closes around it, lifts it from the tabletop, and moves leftward over the plate. It releases the cluster onto the plate near the lower-left interior, then withdraws while the left hand remains still.

Two robotic grippers bring a shiny rectangular metal object into view, rotate it from a diagonal orientation to nearly vertical, and hold it centered between the end effectors. The reflective surface remains upright with only slight settling motion at the end.

A pink two-jaw gripper moves across a white tabletop toward a patterned paper cup, closes around it, and lifts it so the empty interior fills the view. The wrist-mounted camera rotates while carrying the cup past another cup, then the gripper sets the patterned cup upright on the table and withdraws.

An open pink two-finger gripper moves upward toward a tan-and-green sponge near a pale blue bowl. The fingers close around the sponge, bringing it very close to the camera, then carry it across the bowl while the wrist-mounted view tilts and shifts.

The wrist-mounted view moves across the wooden tabletop toward a tall blue rectangular block near the right edge. The yellow jaws close around the block, lift it, and carry it leftward across the taped markings. The gripper lowers and releases the block upright inside the left outlined area, then withdraws.

In a fixed front-facing kitchen view, the dual-armed mobile robot holds both grippers over the counter. Its left arm lifts and draws back, pulling the left upper cabinet door open to reveal a dark interior, while the right arm remains extended near the sink.

Two white robotic grippers move toward a blue bone-shaped object on the mat, close around it, and lift it. The camera travels with the end effectors as they carry the object over an open cardboard box and lower it inside, leaving the box open.

A two-jaw gripper advances toward a red apple on a black perforated work surface, closes around its sides, and carries it forward. A white bowl comes into view beneath the apple; the gripper lowers the apple into the bowl, releases it, and withdraws upward.

A two-jaw gripper moves over the perforated work surface toward a red apple, closes around its sides, and lifts it. The gripper carries the apple leftward and lowers it into a white bowl or plate, releases it centered inside, then withdraws as the view pulls back.

A white robotic gripper approaches the blue bone-shaped toy on the mat, closes around it, and lifts it. It carries the toy rightward over the open cardboard box, lowers it inside, releases it onto the bottom, and withdraws, while a blue robot arm remains beside the box.

The robot arm swings down and forward from above the tiled workspace, extending its two-finger gripper toward a purple cube beside the turquoise block. The gripper reaches the cube near the block's front edge; the cubes and turquoise block remain visibly in place.

A white robotic hand moves in from the right toward a small blue cube beside a white plastic bin. Its fingers close around the cube, lift it from the tabletop, and carry it leftward and upward over the open bin, holding it above the bin by the end.

A single robot arm lowers its blue two-finger gripper around the upright clear plastic tube, closes to lift it, and carries it leftward while holding it angled above the black-covered table near a small clear cup. The arm then returns the tube to its original central area, sets it upright, releases it, and retracts.

The right robotic gripper lifts from the lower right, rotates inward, and moves toward the cross-shaped metal piece near the center. Its orange jaws close around or press against the piece briefly, then open as the arm retracts back toward its starting position; the piece remains on the surface.

The right robotic hand moves toward the green grape-shaped toy beside the pink plate, closes its fingers around it, lifts it, and carries it leftward over the plate. It lowers and releases the toy onto the plate, then withdraws while the left hand remains nearby.

A single articulated robotic hand carries a red apple from the upper right toward the white bin at the center of the table. It lowers the apple over the bin, opens its fingers to release it inside, then lifts and retracts slightly, leaving the apple resting in the bin.

A single robotic hand moves in from the right toward a red apple-like object near the front of the table, closes its fingers around it, and lifts it. The arm carries the object upward and leftward toward the open white bin, ending while holding it above the bin without releasing it.

A mobile robot faces a kitchen counter with both articulated arms extended. Its right arm swings down toward the lower cabinet, grips the drawer handle, and pulls the drawer outward toward the camera, leaving it open while the left arm remains raised. The fixed front-facing camera does not move.

The robotic hand moves a bright pink ball over the white rectangular bin, lowers it inside, and opens its fingers to release it. The ball drops into the bin and settles near the bottom while the arm remains extended above the container.

The right robotic hand moves down toward the pink dragon fruit at the lower right of the table, closes its fingers around it, lifts it, and carries it leftward over the gray plate. The hand lowers the fruit onto the plate and opens, leaving it centered there.

Two black parallel-jaw grippers move around a work surface as a green block is lifted and carried toward a blue rectangular tray. The block passes close to the camera, then is lowered into the tray and released near its lower-right corner. The view pulls back slightly, leaving the block resting inside the tray.

A single white robot arm moves from the left across the countertop, lowers its parallel-jaw gripper beside the white spoon, and slides the spoon toward the near front edge. The pink food-like item remains on the counter as the arm retracts back toward the left. The external oblique camera stays fixed.

A robotic hand carries a red round object from the right toward the white tray at the front of the table. It lowers the object into the tray, releases it, and lifts its fingers away, leaving the red object resting inside the tray.

The right robotic hand moves over the blue and red square rings, presses and slides them together near the lower-right area, then reaches to the green-and-yellow block, grasps it, and places it inside the nested rings. The left robotic hand remains still while the camera stays fixed overhead.

The robot arm advances its anthropomorphic hand toward the blue cube beside the white tray. Its fingers curl around the cube and close to secure it, lifting or holding it just above the tabletop near the tray's right side. The tray remains empty and stationary, and the camera stays fixed.

A single robot arm moves its parallel-jaw gripper to the upper cabinet handle, closes around it, and pulls. The upper blue drawer front swings outward and leftward, revealing the light-colored interior compartment while the lower drawer remains closed. The external side view stays fixed.

A single robotic arm lowers from the right toward the upright yellow cup, aligns its two-finger gripper around the cup rim and side, then closes to secure it. The cup remains near its original position as the arm holds it; the red object, orange object, and white bin stay still.

In the fixed kitchen view, the robot’s right articulated arm swings down from beside the refrigerator toward the mobile base, bending at the elbow and drawing its gripper inward. The left arm remains extended toward the counter while the right arm finishes tucked close to the base.

The right robotic hand moves toward a red apple on the tabletop, closes its fingers around it, lifts it, and carries it rightward into the lower tray of the produce rack. The apple is released beside the other vegetables while the left hand remains open and still.

A two-jaw robot gripper advances toward a red apple on the perforated tabletop, closes around its sides, and lifts it. The gripper carries the apple forward over a white bowl, lowers it into the bowl, releases it, and then moves back, leaving the apple centered inside.

A single robotic hand moves in from the right, reaches toward the tabletop near the white bin, then carries a small yellow cup-like object over the bin. The hand lowers the object into the bin and releases it, leaving the yellow object standing inside while the other toys remain on the table.

A white articulated robotic arm moves in from the right toward the lower handle of a stainless cabinet. Its hand closes around the handle and pulls outward, swinging the lower door toward the camera and revealing dark interior shelves behind it.

A two-jaw gripper approaches a red apple on the perforated tabletop, centers it between its jaws, and carries it upward toward a white dish. The apple is lowered into the dish, then the jaws withdraw, leaving the apple resting inside the dish.

The right robotic hand moves from the lower right toward a small round lid at the center of the table, closes around it, lifts it, and carries it upward into the clear plastic bin. The lid is released inside the bin, and the right hand withdraws while the left hand remains still.

A single robotic arm extends from the right toward the yellow cup near the center of the table. Its articulated hand lowers over the cup, brings its fingers to the rim, and then inserts or presses the fingers into the cup opening while maintaining contact. The cup remains upright as the arm holds position beside it.

A single white robotic arm moves across the stovetop toward the open microwave door, brings its gripper to the door edge, and pulls the black door inward. The door swings closed, covering the microwave opening, while the arm retracts slightly beside the stove.

A white robot arm moves its parallel-jaw gripper toward the upper curved handle of a wooden cabinet, grips it, and pulls straight back. The upper drawer slides outward to the left, revealing its light wooden interior while the lower drawer remains closed.

The parallel-jaw gripper advances toward a black upright rod, closes around it, and carries it forward while the view moves with the end effector. The gripper then opens and withdraws, leaving the rod standing upright in the center of a cross-shaped base.

The robot arm withdraws from the appliance’s front tray, moves rightward and downward across the countertop, and carries a small green item at its end effector. It continues lowering and rotating away from the appliance, ending near the lower-right area of the view with the green item still held.

A single robotic arm carries a cluster of dark purple grapes over a white rectangular bin, lowers them inside, and opens its fingered hand to release the cluster. The grapes settle in the bin while the arm remains extended above it; the orange object and yellow cup stay still.

The robotic hand carries an orange-colored object to the right edge of the table, briefly moves partly out of view, then swings back over the white tray and lowers the object into it. The green pear-shaped object and pink ball remain stationary, while the camera stays fixed overhead.

A single robotic arm moves its hand rightward and downward into the white plastic bin, curling its fingers around an unseen item inside. The orange rubber duck remains upright and unmoved on the left side of the tabletop as the camera stays fixed.

The robotic hand moves in from the right toward the yellow lemon, lowers its fingers around it, closes into a secure grasp, and lifts the lemon slightly off the tabletop while holding it near the lower-right side of the workspace. The white bin and red ball remain stationary.

A single robotic hand moves in from the right toward the black smartphone, lowers its fingers around the phone, closes to grasp it, and lifts it upward and slightly rightward. The phone leaves the tabletop while the nearby yellow and red objects and white bin remain in place.

The right robotic gripper rises from the lower right, reaches toward the central four-spoked fixture, and closes around an orange ribbed piece near it. The arm lifts and reorients the piece against the fixture, holds briefly, then lowers and returns toward its starting position; the left arm remains still.

The left robotic hand moves toward the yellow oval object beside the plate, closes its fingers around it, lifts it from the tabletop, and carries it rightward over the turquoise plate. It releases the object near the plate's center while the right hand remains beside the red fruit.

An anthropomorphic robot hand moves down toward the roll of tan tape on the right side of the table, closes around it, and lifts it slightly while drawing it inward toward the arm. The apple, pear, and empty white bin remain stationary, and the fixed oblique camera view does not move.

The right robotic hand moves toward the green grape cluster, closes its fingers around it, lifts it from the tabletop, carries it leftward over the pink plate, and releases it onto the plate. The left hand remains beside the yellow fruit.

The right robotic hand reaches to the blue square ring, grasps it, and places it inside the larger red square ring. It then picks up the nested green and yellow pieces from the right side and sets them on top, forming a centered multicolored stack while the left hand remains still.

A two-jaw gripper moves upward toward the curved drawer handle as the close camera tilts and rotates with the approach. The drawer front fills the view while the jaws align around the handle, ending in close contact near its center.

The robotic hand moves inward from the right toward the orange object, closes its fingers around it, and lifts it off the tabletop. The hand carries the orange object upward and slightly leftward, leaving the green object, white bin, and phone in their original positions.

The left robotic hand moves in from the left toward the red apple, closes its fingers around it, lifts it, and carries it rightward over the turquoise plate. It lowers the apple onto the plate and releases it, then withdraws while the green grape cluster remains on the right.

The right anthropomorphic robot hand enters holding a yellow corn-shaped object, carries it leftward over the tabletop, and lowers it onto the center of the yellow plate. It opens its fingers to release the object, leaving it resting diagonally on the plate while the hand withdraws to the right.

The right robotic gripper moves toward the white cup at the table’s right edge, closes around it, and lifts it upward. It carries the cup leftward over the wooden stand, tilting and rotating it slightly while the cup remains held. The left anthropomorphic robotic hand stays still.

In the kitchen scene, the mobile robot’s left articulated arm lifts from the counter area, swings upward toward the range hood, then lowers and retracts toward the cabinet. Its other arm remains extended near the countertop. No object transfer or visible state change occurs; the external camera stays fixed.

The left robotic hand moves down to the yellow fruit slice, closes its fingers around it, lifts it, and carries it rightward over the turquoise plate. It releases the slice near the plate center, then withdraws while the right hand remains beside the red apple.

The right robotic hand closes around a translucent brown cup near the center of the table, lifts it, and carries it rightward above a woven basket. It tilts the cup to pour several small orange and blue pieces into the basket, then returns the now-empty cup upright near the center.
